model-first.howto.editproduct:
✏️ Qeemat badalne ke liye product ka naam aur nayi qeemat bol dein, jaise:

"{0} ka rate ab 2000 hai"

Main pehle aap se poochhunga, phir badlunga.
model-first.howto.showcatalog:
📦 Apne products dekhne ke liye bol dein ya likh dein:

"mere products dikhao" ya "catalog"
model-first.howto.addcustomer:
👤 Naya customer rakhne ke liye uska naam, phone aur pata bol dein ya likh dein, jaise:

"Naya customer Bilal Ahmed, 03001234567, Gulberg Lahore"
model-first.howto.editcustomer:
✏️ Customer ka phone ya pata badalne ke liye bol dein, jaise:

"Sara ka phone 03001234567 hai" ya "Sara ka pata ab Model Town hai"
model-first.howto.showcustomer:
👤 Customer ki maloomat ke liye uska naam le kar poochh lein, jaise:

"Sara ka number kya hai" ya "mere customers dikhao"
model-first.howto.updatestatus:
🚚 Order ki halat badalne ke liye bol dein, jaise:

"order 2 bhej diya" ya "Sara ka order pohnch gaya" ya "order 3 wapas aa gaya"
model-first.howto.cancelorder:
❌ Order cancel karne ke liye bol dein ya likh dein:

"order 2 cancel kar do"

Main pehle aap se poochhunga.
model-first.howto.showorders:
📋 Order dekhne ke liye bol dein ya likh dein:

"aaj ke order dikhao", "pending order" ya "order 2 dikhao"
model-first.howto.showsummary:
📊 Hisaab dekhne ke liye bol dein ya likh dein:

"aaj ka hisaab" ya "is hafte kitni sale hui"
model-first.howto.undo:
↩️ Mera aakhri kaam wapas karne ke liye likhein:

undo

model-first.howto.addstock:
📦 Stock barhane ke liye product ka naam aur ginti bol dein, jaise:

"tel ke 2 carton aur aaye" ya "kurti 5 aur aa gayi"
